//: Root tsconfig is solution-style for editor/IDE root resolution only. We deliberately do NOT use TypeScript project references (composite builds) at 0.0.1 — turbo handles cross-package build orchestration, and project refs add ceremony (declaration outputs, build-info, ordering) we don't need yet. Each workspace package owns its own tsconfig that extends tsconfig.base.json. Revisit if/when we hit cross-package type-check speed issues.
